limitations: Independent source review and actual anonymous compile/link/native execution remain required.
These remain local logical-IR contracts; no SQL bag semantics, physical join execution, sharing expansion or aggregate-to-identity lineage proof is claimed.
Existing archived identity/volatile support limits and two domain-spilling shared-origin obligations remain outstanding.
new_contracts: Existing equi-key source/right pairing and EqualNulls flags survive in the inner join.
Every reconstruction key maps to its exact original source and corresponding secondary-port binding; encoded keys are bound to direct Members of the expression row lambda.
Deduplication sits on the inner secondary port; the outer bag uses the primary port.
Accepted left-column residual arguments are renamed exactly and retain the right-column argument.
Correlated subplan left captures are rebound while right captures, local definitions, local expression, call binding and result identity remain unchanged.
Original external projection IDs/order/labels remain available after rewrite; right outputs remain absent for Semi/Only and the zero-column projection retains its expected arity.
